g.text: PARP1 - PNPLA3 | Alphabetical pages; all687 genes retained. No RNA/association significance filter.
Author identities: malignant, normal epithelium, unresolved ductal are distinct. >=20cells per label/type;>=3labels per type. Gray = missing, not zero.
Source labels equally weighted. GSE242230 uses author sample labels. Descriptive expression only; no SC P/q or mechanism inference.
